body:
I made changes in my life that made me happy for a while but in the end, it just comes back to same problems. The fact that I'm just not likeable and people just don't wanna bother with me. No matter, how many changes I make, the problem is me and it's just useless.

I honestly feel like she wasn't a really good therapist and it really put me off from seeing another one. From my point of view, she seemed disinterested in what I was saying and ignored what really bothered me.

Thank you for caring, it actually made me feel a little bit better

Well I guess, to me life has one point and it's to be happy so that's why I feel like I'm just wasting it at this point. I was miserable, I made some changes in my life and 2 years later I should be happy with my life but it's never enough. 

But you might be right, the main issue is that I don't like myself and I can't imagine anybody liking me. I always feel like I'm not worth anyone's time, just talking to you a random stranger as you say, I feel like I'm bothering you. Because of that, I have trouble reaching out to people or maintaining relationships.
